test conflict window
# Check identical files when the paths change between the listing snapshot and the check for identical files
# - Path2 becomes identical to Path1 before the check, with a newer modtime            file1 (file1A, file1B)
# - Both paths change identically before the check on two runs in a row, then stop     file2 (file2A, file2B, file2C)

test initial bisync
bisync resync

test new on both paths, same size and modtime, different content - file1 (file1A, file1B)
touch-glob 2001-01-02 {datadir/} file1*.txt
copy-as {datadir/}file1A.txt {path1/} file1.txt
copy-as {datadir/}file1B.txt {path2/} file1.txt

test bisync with Path2 becoming identical to Path1 before the check, with a newer modtime
touch-glob 2001-03-04 {datadir/} file1A.txt
hook before-check copy-as {datadir/}file1A.txt {path2/} file1.txt
bisync

test bisync after file1 changed before the check
bisync

test recover with --resync if the previous runs failed
bisync resync

test new on both paths and identical - file2 (file2A)
touch-glob 2002-01-02 {datadir/} file2A.txt
copy-as {datadir/}file2A.txt {path1/} file2.txt
copy-as {datadir/}file2A.txt {path2/} file2.txt

test bisync with both paths changing file2 identically before the check
touch-glob 2002-03-04 {datadir/} file2B.txt
hook before-check copy-as {datadir/}file2B.txt {path1/} file2.txt
hook before-check copy-as {datadir/}file2B.txt {path2/} file2.txt
bisync

test bisync with both paths changing file2 identically before the check again
touch-glob 2002-05-06 {datadir/} file2C.txt
hook before-check copy-as {datadir/}file2C.txt {path1/} file2.txt
hook before-check copy-as {datadir/}file2C.txt {path2/} file2.txt
bisync

test bisync after file2 stops changing
bisync
